mira: FYI onboarding Perseus14b (int4) to dedicated. Seeing tail OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 300 and concurrency high.

noah: Are these reproducible in canary or only in production? Any fragmentation metrics?

mira: Repro on canary with synthetic workload. slotstats show free_slots dropping quickly, frag_ratio ~0.48 after ~8 heavy sessions.

tess: Might be kv prefetch + large max_new combined. Prefetch pulls big blocks and leaves gaps on eviction under churn. Quick experiment: disable kv_prefetch and set warmstart_reserve_mb=300. Also try slot_compactor=aggressive for 10m window.

owen: Also limit per-worker batch_limit to 5 to avoid large simultaneous allocations. For safety, lower default max_new_tokens to 128 for initial rollout and gate by eval.

mira: sample failing log from canary node-7:
```
[2024-08-11T09:12:02Z] req=rid-900 model=perseus14b int4 seq_len=512 max_new=512
alloc failed: cudaMalloc returned OOM
kv_cache: reserved=1.9GB active=50 free=2 frag=0.48
Triggering GC -> reclaimed 48MB -> still OOM
```

noah: frag 0.48 is high. Proposed canary config:
```
route: perseus-14b-int4-prefetch-canary
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 128
  batch_limit: 5
  kv_prefetch: false
  slot_compactor: aggressive
  warmstart_reserve_mb: 300
```

tess: +1. Add an SLO-driven fallback: if OOM_rate > 0.5% over 5m then route->perseus14b-int8-lite. That avoids user failures.

mira: deploying canary now, will run 10m at 2x QPS and run eval suite (3k prompts) against canary outputs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route perseus-14b-int4-prefetch-canary by mira at 2024-08-11T09:18:10Z :rocket:

noah: When running load, capture `nvidia-smi` + `slotstats`. If compactor reduces frag, we can make `kv_prefetch=false` permanent for this model.

mira: Initial 5m: zero OOMs, avg p95 latency +4% vs baseline, frag_ratio dropped to 0.14 after compaction.

owen: Good. Next: run eval harness and check generation quality deltas. If NLG metrics degrade >2% on our bench, revert.

tess: Also open a follow-up issue to implement an "evict-before-alloc" path to proactively free slots on large allocs instead of relying on GC. Metricize pre-emptive evictions.

mira: Eval in progress. Will post results in 30m. Thanks! :heart:

deploy-bot: Canary passed smoke checks at 2024-08-11T09:24:55Z.
